definitions.full: H877. bor [ בּאֹר ] noun masculine Jer 2:13 cistern, pit, well (for בְּאֹר compare בּוֺר ) — singular Kt באר 2Sam 23:15-16 , 20 (Qr בֹּר ); apparently well 23:15 ; 23:16 (read perhaps בְּאֵר ), pit 23:20 ; plural Jer 2:13 me they have forsaken, the fountain of living water , נִשְׁבָּרִים בּאֹרֹת בּאֹרוֺת לָהֶם לַחְצֹב , to hew out for themselves cisterns, broken cisterns , etc.

occurrences.englishText: David longed, and said, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
